name: Sika® Filler-105
tagline: Ready to use water based thick layer surface filler
summary: Sika® Filler-105 is a water based, ready to use thick layer surface filler for internal surfaces.
metaDescription: Sika® Filler-105 is a water based, ready to use thick layer surface filler for internal surfaces.
attributes: Ready to use, no mixing required
Thick layer filling and levelling ability
High initial tack or grab on plaster and concrete
usage: Sika® Filler-105 is suitable for indoor filling and repair where thicker filling capability are needed
A finer grade filler such as Sika® Filler-101 should be used for finishing surfaces before painting
Sika® Filler-105 complies with EN 15824 “Specifications for external and internal plasters based on organic binders”
advantages: Ready to use, no mixing required
Thick layer filling and levelling ability
High initial tack or grab on plaster and concrete
packaging: 250 ml plastic tube 400 ml plastic tube 5 Ltr plastic pail

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Internal plaster based on organic binder according to EN 15824, DoP 02 03 04 02 001 0 000017 1084; ITT performed by external laboratory 0402; System 3 certification and provided with the CE-mark

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged and unopened original sealed packaging

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry conditions. Protect from frost.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text: ~ 12 hours (ideally surfaces should be finished with a fine layer filler such as Sika® Filler-101)

items.label: Consumption
items.text: This depends on the substrate roughness and thickness of the layer applied. As a guide, ~ 1 l of Sika® Filler-105 can fill ~ 1 m2 per mm thick.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Sika® Filler-105 is supplied ready to use - no mixing is required.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Sika® Filler-105 can be applied with a spatula in layer thicknesses from 0 - 30 mm. When filling deep holes or cracks above 4 mm the filler should be applied in several layers and must be allowed to almost dry before each subsequent layer is applied

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.
